blurb: 5 Star Helicopter Tours operates from a private VIP heliport near the Las Vegas Strip. They offer panoramic helicopter tours with forward-facing seats and leather interiors. Tours include narration by FAA Certified Pilots and cover landmarks such as the Grand Canyon West Rim, Hoover Dam, Red Rock Canyon, and Valley of Fire.
